item.text: {"rule":"The procedure used two elimination steps: after each petting choice, either the petted cat(s) stayed or they left, and the sole survivor became final. The observations are insufficient to infer how the stay/leave decision was made; the same unordered pair sometimes produced different outcomes, possibly because selection order or the round mattered."}
